subject.title: Cron running_at_ms not cleared after agentTurn run

question: Should maintainers route this issue through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/81572, or require a narrower reproduction/fix for the reported recurring isolated `agentTurn` job?
rationale: The open PR targets the strongest source-backed stale-marker class, but this issue reports a latest-release recurring cron and current source also has a terminal clear path, so a maintainer should choose the proof/fix path before a duplicate repair lane starts.

options.title: Use the open PR as candidate fix
options.body: Review or adapt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/81572 and add an exact recurring isolated `agentTurn` SQLite regression if it is the same root cause.

options.title: Request live repro first
options.body: Keep this issue open with live-repro follow-up until a current-main gateway run proves the single-job latest-release failure path.

options.title: Open a narrow replacement fix
options.body: If the open PR is not the same root cause, implement a smaller timer/store repair scoped to this recurring `agentTurn` case.

recommendation.title: Use the open PR as candidate fix
recommendation.body: Review or adapt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/81572 and add an exact recurring isolated `agentTurn` SQLite regression if it is the same root cause.

likelyOwner.reason: The original cron scheduler and later isolated cron watchdog work make steipete the best available routing owner for deciding whether the open persistence PR covers this report.
